comment: The second amplitude jack is lettered Amps 15-31 on the panel and named AMP 16-31 in the tooltip, while the code fills partials 16 to 31 counting from zero, AddSynth.cpp:229-231, so the panel lettering overlaps the first jack by one. The damping is an exponential curve over the partial number, AddSynth.cpp:236. Each partial's phase step is clamped, AddSynth.cpp:222, so partials above half the sample rate fold rather than alias freely.
